How SafeReach Works

Simple 4-Step Community Escalation

Designed specifically for rapid multi-tier community coordination during medical, fire, safety, or personal emergencies.

01
🚨

Senior Citizen SOS

The resident presses the 1-touch SOS trigger on mobile or web. Emergency is logged immediately.

02
📍

Live GPS Location

High-precision GPS coordinates and medical profiles are instantly captured and broadcast to responders.

03
🔔

Multi-Tier Alerting

Linked Family members, Nearby Neighbors, Security Guards, and Volunteers receive instant FCM & Socket alerts.

04
🤝

Help Arrives Fast

The closest responder accepts the alert, coordinates response, and resolves the situation on-site.

Platform Capabilities

Built for Real-Time Community Safety

Everything your gated community, apartment complex, or neighborhood needs to protect vulnerable residents.

📍

Live GPS Tracking

Real-time interactive Leaflet maps showing exact location coordinates and responder navigation paths.

⚡

Instant Socket.IO Alerts

Sub-second real-time websocket broadcasts to all active dashboards with audible alarm tones.

📲

FCM Push Notifications

Foreground and background push notifications delivered straight to Android smartphones via Capacitor.

🛡️

Multi-Tier Escalation

60-second automated escalation ladder: Tier 1 (Family) ➔ Tier 2 (Neighbors) ➔ Tier 3 (Security Guards & Volunteers).

🌐

Multilingual Support

Full interface translation and screen reader voice synthesis across English, Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, and more.

👁️

Inclusive Accessibility

High contrast toggle, text resizing, voice commands, and speech-to-text navigation for seniors.
